verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships the Inso CLI, which the docs say is built to run in CI: it disables prompts and returns exit codes that pass or fail the workflow. The docs also show it automating API tests from Git workflows and running `inso lint spec` to fail builds on OpenAPI errors. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use, and explicit documentation of running collection-runner workflows headlessly via the CLI.
